header: The FRONT-PATH GATE (step 24a of the front-path plan, HANDOFF_dsp-intranet_front-path.md: "cheap first, model later"). THE PROBLEM it addresses: every question that is not a holiday question is first sent to the language model (about 4,900 tokens and 1 to 5 seconds) so the model can say "this is not an employee question", and only then does circular search run. For a question like "what is the leave policy for contract workers" that model call is pure waste. THE GATE: I let a question be an employee-directory or health check-up question ONLY if it points at something in that data: a person who works here, a department, a ticket number, or one of the words that name what the directory holds (employee, executive, designation, senior, mobile, e-mail, health check-up ...). A question with NONE of those cannot be answered by the model's SQL, so I skip the model and let circular search answer first. WHY IT IS SAFE: (1) "a person who works here" is asked of the directory itself (every name word of nlq.employees), not of a hand-written list, so surnames inside sentences ("list all mazumdars") are caught; (2) the gate only changes the ORDER: if circular search then finds nothing, or fails, the route asks the model after all (see route.ts, rescueWithModel), so a wrong skip costs time, never a wrong answer; (3) it is OFF unless FRONT_PATH_SKIP_MODEL=true, so I can A/B it with the acceptance harness (node scripts/omnibar-acceptance.mjs ... then --compare) before trusting it. Pure except loadDirectoryNameWords (one cached query). Unit-tested by frontGate.selftest.ts on the acceptance set.

symbols.name: frontGateEnabled
symbols.sig: export function frontGateEnabled(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): boolean
doc: The gate is on only when FRONT_PATH_SKIP_MODEL=true. Anything else (unset, "false", "1") keeps today's behaviour exactly.

symbols.name: PEOPLE_DATA_WORDS
doc: The words that name what the employee directory and the health check-up schedules hold. I made this a linguistic class (who / what-kind-of-person / which-data-field), not a list of phrasings. A word here only ever makes the gate say "ask the model", which is the safe direction.

symbols.name: ID_LIKE
doc: A ticket / mobile / P.No: 5 to 10 digits, or a letter followed by 4+ digits, or a 4-digit number that is not a plausible year.

members.name: isNameShaped
doc: Comes from the route's own check: the whole question is a person's name (phonetic match against the directory).

members.name: deptMentioned
doc: Comes from the route's own check: the question names one of the plant's departments.

members.name: directoryWords
doc: Every name word in the directory, lower-case (loadDirectoryNameWords). An empty set means "unknown", and then I never skip.

members.name: reason
doc: Why the model is still needed, or why it can be skipped. It is shown in the trace and in the tests.

symbols.name: directoryWordIn
symbols.sig: export function directoryWordIn(q: string, directoryWords: ReadonlySet<string>): string | null
doc: Returns the first word of the question that is a name in the directory, or null. I match singular or plural: the directory holds "MAZUMDAR", people say "mazumdars".

symbols.name: namesSomeone
symbols.sig: export function namesSomeone(q: string, i: { isNameShaped: boolean; directoryWords: ReadonlySet<string> }): boolean
doc: True when the question points at ONE particular person or ticket: the whole question is a name, it holds a ticket-like number, or a word of it is a name in the directory. I do not count the general people-data words (employees, executives, health check-up ...): they name what the data holds, not who.

symbols.name: wordsCache
symbols.sig: let wordsCache: { words: Set<string>; at: number } | null = null

symbols.name: loadDirectoryNameWords
symbols.sig: export async function loadDirectoryNameWords( run: (sql: string) => Promise<Array<{ w: string }>>, now: number = Date.now(),): Promise<Set<string>>
doc: Every name word of every employee, lower-case: one cheap query, cached for ten minutes. It throws when the list cannot be loaded or is empty; the caller then simply does not skip, which is today's behaviour.

behaviours: off by default
off for 'false'
off for '1' (only the word true turns it on)
on for ' TRUE '
a plain document question skips the model
an unknown directory never skips
a name-shaped question never skips
a department mention never skips
a people-data word never skips
a ticket number never skips
a year is not a ticket
a 4-digit number that is not a year blocks
a surname inside a sentence blocks
a plural surname blocks
a non-Latin question is not judged
an empty question never skips
the reason is always given
no employee / health check-up question in the set is skipped (${needsModel.length} checked)
the gate saves a real share of the document questions (${saved.length} of ${documents.length})
no unseen employee-style question is skipped (${UNSEEN.length} checked)
most unseen plain document questions skip the model (${unseenSaved.length} of ${UNSEEN_DOCS.length})
words load once and are cached
two-letter fragments are dropped
the cache expires after ten minutes
an empty directory throws (the caller then does not skip)
a failed query throws (the caller then does not skip)
